   470→function _isValidProtocol(url) {
   471→  switch (url?.protocol) {
   472→    case "http:":
   473→    case "https:":
   474→    case "ftp:":
   475→    case "mailto:":
   476→    case "tel:":
   477→      return true;
   478→    default:
   479→      return false;
   480→  }
   481→}
   482→function createValidAbsoluteUrl(url, baseUrl = null, options = null) {
   483→  if (!url) {
   484→    return null;
   485→  }
   486→  try {
   487→    if (options && typeof url === "string") {
   488→      if (options.addDefaultProtocol && url.startsWith("www.")) {
   489→        const dots = url.match(/\./g);
   490→        if (dots?.length >= 2) {
   491→          url = `http://${url}`;
   492→        }
   493→      }
   494→      if (options.tryConvertEncoding) {
   495→        try {
   496→          url = stringToUTF8String(url);
   497→        } catch {
   498→        }
   499→      }
   500→    }
   501→    const absoluteUrl = baseUrl ? new URL(url, baseUrl) : new URL(url);
   502→    if (_isValidProtocol(absoluteUrl)) {
   503→      return absoluteUrl;
   504→    }
   505→  } catch {
   506→  }
   507→  return null;
   508→}
   509→function shadow(obj, prop, value, nonSerializable = false) {
   510→  Object.defineProperty(obj, prop, {
   511→    value,
   512→    enumerable: !nonSerializable,
   513→    configurable: true,
   514→    writable: false
   515→  });
   516→  return value;
   517→}

   565→function bytesToString(bytes) {
   566→  if (typeof bytes !== "object" || bytes?.length === void 0) {
   567→    unreachable("Invalid argument for bytesToString");
   568→  }
   569→  const length = bytes.length;
   570→  const MAX_ARGUMENT_COUNT = 8192;
   571→  if (length < MAX_ARGUMENT_COUNT) {
   572→    return String.fromCharCode.apply(null, bytes);
   573→  }
   574→  const strBuf = [];
   575→  for (let i = 0; i < length; i += MAX_ARGUMENT_COUNT) {
   576→    const chunkEnd = Math.min(i + MAX_ARGUMENT_COUNT, length);
   577→    const chunk = bytes.subarray(i, chunkEnd);
   578→    strBuf.push(String.fromCharCode.apply(null, chunk));
   579→  }
   580→  return strBuf.join("");
   581→}
   582→function stringToBytes(str) {
   583→  if (typeof str !== "string") {
   584→    unreachable("Invalid argument for stringToBytes");
   585→  }
   586→  const length = str.length;
   587→  const bytes = new Uint8Array(length);
   588→  for (let i = 0; i < length; ++i) {
   589→    bytes[i] = str.charCodeAt(i) & 255;
   590→  }
   591→  return bytes;
   592→}
   593→function string32(value) {
   594→  return String.fromCharCode(value >> 24 & 255, value >> 16 & 255, value >> 8 & 255, value & 255);
   595→}
   596→function objectFromMap(map) {
   597→  const obj = /* @__PURE__ */ Object.create(null);
   598→  for (const [key, value] of map) {
   599→    obj[key] = value;
   600→  }
   601→  return obj;
   602→}
   603→function isLittleEndian() {
   604→  const buffer8 = new Uint8Array(4);
   605→  buffer8[0] = 1;
   606→  const view32 = new Uint32Array(buffer8.buffer, 0, 1);
   607→  return view32[0] === 1;
   608→}
   609→function isEvalSupported() {
   610→  try {
   611→    new Function("");
   612→    return true;
   613→  } catch {
   614→    return false;
   615→  }
   616→}

   635→        isFirefox: typeof navigator?.userAgent === "string" && navigator.userAgent.includes("Firefox")
   636→      });

   640→      isWindows: false,
   641→      isFirefox: false
   642→    });

   648→var hexNumbers = Array.from(Array(256).keys(), (n) => n.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"));
   649→var Util = class {
   650→  static makeHexColor(r, g, b) {
   651→    return `#${hexNumbers[r]}${hexNumbers[g]}${hexNumbers[b]}`;
   652→  }
   653→  static scaleMinMax(transform, minMax) {
   654→    let temp;
   655→    if (transform[0]) {
   656→      if (transform[0] < 0) {
   657→        temp = minMax[0];
   658→        minMax[0] = minMax[2];
   659→        minMax[2] = temp;
   660→      }
   661→      minMax[0] *= transform[0];
   662→      minMax[2] *= transform[0];
   663→      if (transform[3] < 0) {
   664→        temp = minMax[1];
   665→        minMax[1] = minMax[3];
   666→        minMax[3] = temp;
   667→      }
   668→      minMax[1] *= transform[3];
   669→      minMax[3] *= transform[3];
   670→    } else {
   671→      temp = minMax[0];
   672→      minMax[0] = minMax[1];
   673→      minMax[1] = temp;
   674→      temp = minMax[2];
   675→      minMax[2] = minMax[3];
   676→      minMax[3] = temp;
   677→      if (transform[1] < 0) {
   678→        temp = minMax[1];
   679→        minMax[1] = minMax[3];
   680→        minMax[3] = temp;
   681→      }
   682→      minMax[1] *= transform[1];
   683→      minMax[3] *= transform[1];
   684→      if (transform[2] < 0) {
   685→        temp = minMax[0];
   686→        minMax[0] = minMax[2];
   687→        minMax[2] = temp;
   688→      }
   689→      minMax[0] *= transform[2];
   690→      minMax[2] *= transform[2];
   691→    }
   692→    minMax[0] += transform[4];
   693→    minMax[1] += transform[5];
   694→    minMax[2] += transform[4];
   695→    minMax[3] += transform[5];
   696→  }
   697→  static transform(m1, m2) {
   698→    return [m1[0] * m2[0] + m1[2] * m2[1], m1[1] * m2[0] + m1[3] * m2[1], m1[0] * m2[2] + m1[2] * m2[3], m1[1] * m2[2] + m1[3] * m2[3], m1[0] * m2[4] + m1[2] * m2[5] + m1[4], m1[1] * m2[4] + m1[3] * m2[5] + m1[5]];
   699→  }
   700→  static applyTransform(p, m) {
   701→    const xt = p[0] * m[0] + p[1] * m[2] + m[4];
   702→    const yt = p[0] * m[1] + p[1] * m[3] + m[5];
   703→    return [xt, yt];
   704→  }
   705→  static applyInverseTransform(p, m) {
   706→    const d = m[0] * m[3] - m[1] * m[2];
   707→    const xt = (p[0] * m[3] - p[1] * m[2] + m[2] * m[5] - m[4] * m[3]) / d;
   708→    const yt = (-p[0] * m[1] + p[1] * m[0] + m[4] * m[1] - m[5] * m[0]) / d;
   709→    return [xt, yt];
   710→  }
   711→  static getAxialAlignedBoundingBox(r, m) {
   712→    const p1 = this.applyTransform(r, m);
   713→    const p2 = this.applyTransform(r.slice(2, 4), m);
   714→    const p3 = this.applyTransform([r[0], r[3]], m);
   715→    const p4 = this.applyTransform([r[2], r[1]], m);
   716→    return [Math.min(p1[0], p2[0], p3[0], p4[0]), Math.min(p1[1], p2[1], p3[1], p4[1]), Math.max(p1[0], p2[0], p3[0], p4[0]), Math.max(p1[1], p2[1], p3[1], p4[1])];
   717→  }
   718→  static inverseTransform(m) {
   719→    const d = m[0] * m[3] - m[1] * m[2];
   720→    return [m[3] / d, -m[1] / d, -m[2] / d, m[0] / d, (m[2] * m[5] - m[4] * m[3]) / d, (m[4] * m[1] - m[5] * m[0]) / d];
   721→  }
   722→  static singularValueDecompose2dScale(m) {
   723→    const transpose = [m[0], m[2], m[1], m[3]];
   724→    const a = m[0] * transpose[0] + m[1] * transpose[2];
   725→    const b = m[0] * transpose[1] + m[1] * transpose[3];
   726→    const c = m[2] * transpose[0] + m[3] * transpose[2];
   727→    const d = m[2] * transpose[1] + m[3] * transpose[3];
   728→    const first = (a + d) / 2;
   729→    const second = Math.sqrt((a + d) ** 2 - 4 * (a * d - c * b)) / 2;
   730→    const sx = first + second || 1;
   731→    const sy = first - second || 1;
   732→    return [Math.sqrt(sx), Math.sqrt(sy)];
   733→  }
   734→  static normalizeRect(rect) {
   735→    const r = rect.slice(0);
   736→    if (rect[0] > rect[2]) {
   737→      r[0] = rect[2];
   738→      r[2] = rect[0];
   739→    }
   740→    if (rect[1] > rect[3]) {
   741→      r[1] = rect[3];
   742→      r[3] = rect[1];
   743→    }
   744→    return r;
   745→  }
   746→  static intersect(rect1, rect2) {
   747→    const xLow = Math.max(Math.min(rect1[0], rect1[2]), Math.min(rect2[0], rect2[2]));
   748→    const xHigh = Math.min(Math.max(rect1[0], rect1[2]), Math.max(rect2[0], rect2[2]));
   749→    if (xLow > xHigh) {
   750→      return null;
   751→    }
   752→    const yLow = Math.max(Math.min(rect1[1], rect1[3]), Math.min(rect2[1], rect2[3]));
   753→    const yHigh = Math.min(Math.max(rect1[1], rect1[3]), Math.max(rect2[1], rect2[3]));
   754→    if (yLow > yHigh) {
   755→      return null;
   756→    }
   757→    return [xLow, yLow, xHigh, yHigh];
   758→  }
   759→  static #getExtremumOnCurve(x0, x1, x2, x3, y0, y1, y2, y3, t, minMax) {
   760→    if (t <= 0 || t >= 1) {
   761→      return;
   762→    }
   763→    const mt = 1 - t;
   764→    const tt = t * t;
   765→    const ttt = tt * t;
   766→    const x = mt * (mt * (mt * x0 + 3 * t * x1) + 3 * tt * x2) + ttt * x3;
   767→    const y = mt * (mt * (mt * y0 + 3 * t * y1) + 3 * tt * y2) + ttt * y3;
   768→    minMax[0] = Math.min(minMax[0], x);
   769→    minMax[1] = Math.min(minMax[1], y);
   770→    minMax[2] = Math.max(minMax[2], x);
   771→    minMax[3] = Math.max(minMax[3], y);
   772→  }
   773→  static #getExtremum(x0, x1, x2, x3, y0, y1, y2, y3, a, b, c, minMax) {
   774→    if (Math.abs(a) < 1e-12) {
   775→      if (Math.abs(b) >= 1e-12) {
   776→        this.#getExtremumOnCurve(x0, x1, x2, x3, y0, y1, y2, y3, -c / b, minMax);
   777→      }
   778→      return;
   779→    }
   780→    const delta = b ** 2 - 4 * c * a;
   781→    if (delta < 0) {
   782→      return;
   783→    }
   784→    const sqrtDelta = Math.sqrt(delta);
   785→    const a2 = 2 * a;
   786→    this.#getExtremumOnCurve(x0, x1, x2, x3, y0, y1, y2, y3, (-b + sqrtDelta) / a2, minMax);
   787→    this.#getExtremumOnCurve(x0, x1, x2, x3, y0, y1, y2, y3, (-b - sqrtDelta) / a2, minMax);
   788→  }
   789→  static bezierBoundingBox(x0, y0, x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3, minMax) {
   790→    if (minMax) {
   791→      minMax[0] = Math.min(minMax[0], x0, x3);
   792→      minMax[1] = Math.min(minMax[1], y0, y3);
   793→      minMax[2] = Math.max(minMax[2], x0, x3);
   794→      minMax[3] = Math.max(minMax[3], y0, y3);
   795→    } else {
   796→      minMax = [Math.min(x0, x3), Math.min(y0, y3), Math.max(x0, x3), Math.max(y0, y3)];
   797→    }
   798→    this.#getExtremum(x0, x1, x2, x3, y0, y1, y2, y3, 3 * (-x0 + 3 * (x1 - x2) + x3), 6 * (x0 - 2 * x1 + x2), 3 * (x1 - x0), minMax);
   799→    this.#getExtremum(x0, x1, x2, x3, y0, y1, y2, y3, 3 * (-y0 + 3 * (y1 - y2) + y3), 6 * (y0 - 2 * y1 + y2), 3 * (y1 - y0), minMax);
   800→    return minMax;
   801→  }
   802→};
   803→function stringToUTF8String(str) {
   804→  return decodeURIComponent(escape(str));
   805→}
   806→var NormalizeRegex = null;
   807→var NormalizationMap = null;
   808→function normalizeUnicode(str) {
   809→  if (!NormalizeRegex) {
   810→    NormalizeRegex = /([\u00a0\u00b5\u037e\u0eb3\u2000-\u200a\u202f\u2126\ufb00-\ufb04\ufb06\ufb20-\ufb36\ufb38-\ufb3c\ufb3e\ufb40-\ufb41\ufb43-\ufb44\ufb46-\ufba1\ufba4-\ufba9\ufbae-\ufbb1\ufbd3-\ufbdc\ufbde-\ufbe7\ufbea-\ufbf8\ufbfc-\ufbfd\ufc00-\ufc5d\ufc64-\ufcf1\ufcf5-\ufd3d\ufd88\ufdf4\ufdfa-\ufdfb\ufe71\ufe77\ufe79\ufe7b\ufe7d]+)|(\ufb05+)/gu;
   811→    NormalizationMap = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map([["\uFB05", "\u017Ft"]]);
   812→  }
   813→  return str.replaceAll(NormalizeRegex, (_, p1, p2) => p1 ? p1.normalize("NFKC") : NormalizationMap.get(p2));
   814→}
   815→function getUuid() {

   817→    return crypto.randomUUID();
   818→  }
   819→  const buf = new Uint8Array(32);
   820→  crypto.getRandomValues(buf);
   821→  return bytesToString(buf);
   822→}

   854→async function fetchData(url, type = "text") {
   855→  if (isValidFetchUrl(url, document.baseURI)) {
   856→    const response = await fetch(url);
   857→    if (!response.ok) {
   858→      throw new Error(response.statusText);
   859→    }
   860→    switch (type) {
   861→      case "arraybuffer":
   862→        return response.arrayBuffer();
   863→      case "blob":
   864→        return response.blob();
   865→      case "json":
   866→        return response.json();
   867→    }
   868→    return response.text();
   869→  }
   870→  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
   871→    const request = new XMLHttpRequest();
   872→    request.open("GET", url, true);
   873→    request.responseType = type;
   874→    request.onreadystatechange = () => {
   875→      if (request.readyState !== XMLHttpRequest.DONE) {
   876→        return;
   877→      }
   878→      if (request.status === 200 || request.status === 0) {
   879→        switch (type) {
   880→          case "arraybuffer":
   881→          case "blob":
   882→          case "json":
   883→            resolve(request.response);
   884→            return;
   885→        }
   886→        resolve(request.responseText);
   887→        return;
   888→      }
   889→      reject(new Error(request.statusText));
   890→    };
   891→    request.send(null);
   892→  });
   893→}
   894→var PageViewport = class _PageViewport {
   895→  constructor({
   896→    viewBox,
   897→    scale,
   898→    rotation,
   899→    offsetX = 0,
   900→    offsetY = 0,
   901→    dontFlip = false
   902→  }) {
   903→    this.viewBox = viewBox;
   904→    this.scale = scale;
   905→    this.rotation = rotation;
   906→    this.offsetX = offsetX;
   907→    this.offsetY = offsetY;
   908→    const centerX = (viewBox[2] + viewBox[0]) / 2;
   909→    const centerY = (viewBox[3] + viewBox[1]) / 2;
   910→    let rotateA, rotateB, rotateC, rotateD;
   911→    rotation %= 360;
   912→    if (rotation < 0) {
   913→      rotation += 360;
   914→    }
   915→    switch (rotation) {
   916→      case 180:
   917→        rotateA = -1;
   918→        rotateB = 0;
   919→        rotateC = 0;
   920→        rotateD = 1;
   921→        break;
   922→      case 90:
   923→        rotateA = 0;
   924→        rotateB = 1;
   925→        rotateC = 1;
   926→        rotateD = 0;
   927→        break;
   928→      case 270:
   929→        rotateA = 0;
   930→        rotateB = -1;
   931→        rotateC = -1;
   932→        rotateD = 0;
   933→        break;
   934→      case 0:
   935→        rotateA = 1;
   936→        rotateB = 0;
   937→        rotateC = 0;
   938→        rotateD = -1;
   939→        break;
   940→      default:
   941→        throw new Error("PageViewport: Invalid rotation, must be a multiple of 90 degrees.");
   942→    }
   943→    if (dontFlip) {
   944→      rotateC = -rotateC;
   945→      rotateD = -rotateD;
   946→    }
   947→    let offsetCanvasX, offsetCanvasY;
   948→    let width, height;
   949→    if (rotateA === 0) {
   950→      offsetCanvasX = Math.abs(centerY - viewBox[1]) * scale + offsetX;
   951→      offsetCanvasY = Math.abs(centerX - viewBox[0]) * scale + offsetY;
   952→      width = (viewBox[3] - viewBox[1]) * scale;
   953→      height = (viewBox[2] - viewBox[0]) * scale;
   954→    } else {
   955→      offsetCanvasX = Math.abs(centerX - viewBox[0]) * scale + offsetX;
   956→      offsetCanvasY = Math.abs(centerY - viewBox[1]) * scale + offsetY;
   957→      width = (viewBox[2] - viewBox[0]) * scale;
   958→      height = (viewBox[3] - viewBox[1]) * scale;
   959→    }
   960→    this.transform = [rotateA * scale, rotateB * scale, rotateC * scale, rotateD * scale, offsetCanvasX - rotateA * scale * centerX - rotateC * scale * centerY, offsetCanvasY - rotateB * scale * centerX - rotateD * scale * centerY];
   961→    this.width = width;
   962→    this.height = height;
   963→  }
   964→  get rawDims() {
   965→    const {
   966→      viewBox
   967→    } = this;
   968→    return shadow(this, "rawDims", {
   969→      pageWidth: viewBox[2] - viewBox[0],
   970→      pageHeight: viewBox[3] - viewBox[1],
   971→      pageX: viewBox[0],
   972→      pageY: viewBox[1]
   973→    });
   974→  }
   975→  clone({
   976→    scale = this.scale,
   977→    rotation = this.rotation,
   978→    offsetX = this.offsetX,
   979→    offsetY = this.offsetY,
   980→    dontFlip = false
   981→  } = {}) {
   982→    return new _PageViewport({
   983→      viewBox: this.viewBox.slice(),
   984→      scale,
   985→      rotation,
   986→      offsetX,
   987→      offsetY,
   988→      dontFlip
   989→    });
   990→  }
   991→  convertToViewportPoint(x, y) {
   992→    return Util.applyTransform([x, y], this.transform);
   993→  }
   994→  convertToViewportRectangle(rect) {
   995→    const topLeft = Util.applyTransform([rect[0], rect[1]], this.transform);
   996→    const bottomRight = Util.applyTransform([rect[2], rect[3]], this.transform);
   997→    return [topLeft[0], topLeft[1], bottomRight[0], bottomRight[1]];
   998→  }
   999→  convertToPdfPoint(x, y) {
  1000→    return Util.applyInverseTransform([x, y], this.transform);
  1001→  }
  1002→};

  1009→function isDataScheme(url) {
  1010→  const ii = url.length;
  1011→  let i = 0;
  1012→  while (i < ii && url[i].trim() === "") {
  1013→    i++;
  1014→  }
  1015→  return url.substring(i, i + 5).toLowerCase() === "data:";
  1016→}
  1017→function isPdfFile(filename) {

  1019→}
  1020→function getFilenameFromUrl(url) {
  1021→  [url] = url.split(/[#?]/, 1);
  1022→  return url.substring(url.lastIndexOf("/") + 1);
  1023→}
  1024→function getPdfFilenameFromUrl(url, defaultFilename = "document.pdf") {
  1025→  if (typeof url !== "string") {
  1026→    return defaultFilename;
  1027→  }
  1028→  if (isDataScheme(url)) {
  1029→    warn('getPdfFilenameFromUrl: ignore "data:"-URL for performance reasons.');
  1030→    return defaultFilename;
  1031→  }
  1032→  const reURI = /^(?:(?:[^:]+:)?\/\/[^/]+)?([^?#]*)(\?[^#]*)?(#.*)?$/;
  1033→  const reFilename = /[^/?#=]+\.pdf\b(?!.*\.pdf\b)/i;
  1034→  const splitURI = reURI.exec(url);
  1035→  let suggestedFilename = reFilename.exec(splitURI[1]) || reFilename.exec(splitURI[2]) || reFilename.exec(splitURI[3]);
  1036→  if (suggestedFilename) {
  1037→    suggestedFilename = suggestedFilename[0];
  1038→    if (suggestedFilename.includes("%")) {
  1039→      try {
  1040→        suggestedFilename = reFilename.exec(decodeURIComponent(suggestedFilename))[0];
  1041→      } catch {
  1042→      }
  1043→    }
  1044→  }
  1045→  return suggestedFilename || defaultFilename;
  1046→}
  1047→var StatTimer = class {
  1048→  started = /* @__PURE__ */ Object.create(null);
  1049→  times = [];
  1050→  time(name) {
  1051→    if (name in this.started) {
  1052→      warn(`Timer is already running for ${name}`);
  1053→    }
  1054→    this.started[name] = Date.now();
  1055→  }
  1056→  timeEnd(name) {
  1057→    if (!(name in this.started)) {
  1058→      warn(`Timer has not been started for ${name}`);
  1059→    }
  1060→    this.times.push({
  1061→      name,
  1062→      start: this.started[name],
  1063→      end: Date.now()
  1064→    });
  1065→    delete this.started[name];
  1066→  }
  1067→  toString() {
  1068→    const outBuf = [];
  1069→    let longest = 0;
  1070→    for (const {
  1071→      name
  1072→    } of this.times) {
  1073→      longest = Math.max(name.length, longest);
  1074→    }
  1075→    for (const {
  1076→      name,
  1077→      start,
  1078→      end
  1079→    } of this.times) {
  1080→      outBuf.push(`${name.padEnd(longest)} ${end - start}ms
  1081→`);
  1082→    }
  1083→    return outBuf.join("");
  1084→  }
  1085→};

  1091→    return protocol === "http:" || protocol === "https:";
  1092→  } catch {
  1093→    return false;
  1094→  }

  1106→var PDFDateString = class {
  1107→  static #regex;
  1108→  static toDateObject(input) {
  1109→    if (!input || typeof input !== "string") {
  1110→      return null;
  1111→    }
  1112→    this.#regex ||= new RegExp("^D:(\\d{4})(\\d{2})?(\\d{2})?(\\d{2})?(\\d{2})?(\\d{2})?([Z|+|-])?(\\d{2})?'?(\\d{2})?'?");
  1113→    const matches = this.#regex.exec(input);
  1114→    if (!matches) {
  1115→      return null;
  1116→    }
  1117→    const year = parseInt(matches[1], 10);
  1118→    let month = parseInt(matches[2], 10);
  1119→    month = month >= 1 && month <= 12 ? month - 1 : 0;
  1120→    let day = parseInt(matches[3], 10);
  1121→    day = day >= 1 && day <= 31 ? day : 1;
  1122→    let hour = parseInt(matches[4], 10);
  1123→    hour = hour >= 0 && hour <= 23 ? hour : 0;
  1124→    let minute = parseInt(matches[5], 10);
  1125→    minute = minute >= 0 && minute <= 59 ? minute : 0;
  1126→    let second = parseInt(matches[6], 10);
  1127→    second = second >= 0 && second <= 59 ? second : 0;
  1128→    const universalTimeRelation = matches[7] || "Z";
  1129→    let offsetHour = parseInt(matches[8], 10);
  1130→    offsetHour = offsetHour >= 0 && offsetHour <= 23 ? offsetHour : 0;
  1131→    let offsetMinute = parseInt(matches[9], 10) || 0;
  1132→    offsetMinute = offsetMinute >= 0 && offsetMinute <= 59 ? offsetMinute : 0;
  1133→    if (universalTimeRelation === "-") {
  1134→      hour += offsetHour;
  1135→      minute += offsetMinute;
  1136→    } else if (universalTimeRelation === "+") {
  1137→      hour -= offsetHour;
  1138→      minute -= offsetMinute;
  1139→    }
  1140→    return new Date(Date.UTC(year, month, day, hour, minute, second));
  1141→  }

  1143→function getXfaPageViewport(xfaPage, {
  1144→  scale = 1,
  1145→  rotation = 0
  1146→}) {
  1147→  const {
  1148→    width,
  1149→    height
  1150→  } = xfaPage.attributes.style;
  1151→  const viewBox = [0, 0, parseInt(width), parseInt(height)];
  1152→  return new PageViewport({
  1153→    viewBox,
  1154→    scale,
  1155→    rotation
  1156→  });
  1157→}
  1158→function getRGB(color) {
  1159→  if (color.startsWith("#")) {
  1160→    const colorRGB = parseInt(color.slice(1), 16);
  1161→    return [(colorRGB & 16711680) >> 16, (colorRGB & 65280) >> 8, colorRGB & 255];
  1162→  }
  1163→  if (color.startsWith("rgb(")) {
  1164→    return color.slice(4, -1).split(",").map((x) => parseInt(x));
  1165→  }
  1166→  if (color.startsWith("rgba(")) {
  1167→    return color.slice(5, -1).split(",").map((x) => parseInt(x)).slice(0, 3);
  1168→  }
  1169→  warn(`Not a valid color format: "${color}"`);
  1170→  return [0, 0, 0];
  1171→}
  1172→function getColorValues(colors) {
  1173→  const span = document.createElement("span");
  1174→  span.style.visibility = "hidden";
  1175→  document.body.append(span);
  1176→  for (const name of colors.keys()) {
  1177→    span.style.color = name;
  1178→    const computedColor = window.getComputedStyle(span).color;
  1179→    colors.set(name, getRGB(computedColor));
  1180→  }
  1181→  span.remove();
  1182→}
  1183→function getCurrentTransform(ctx) {
  1184→  const {
  1185→    a,
  1186→    b,
  1187→    c,
  1188→    d,
  1189→    e,
  1190→    f
  1191→  } = ctx.getTransform();
  1192→  return [a, b, c, d, e, f];
  1193→}
  1194→function getCurrentTransformInverse(ctx) {
  1195→  const {
  1196→    a,
  1197→    b,
  1198→    c,
  1199→    d,
  1200→    e,
  1201→    f
  1202→  } = ctx.getTransform().invertSelf();
  1203→  return [a, b, c, d, e, f];
  1204→}
  1205→function setLayerDimensions(div, viewport, mustFlip = false, mustRotate = true) {
  1206→  if (viewport instanceof PageViewport) {
  1207→    const {
  1208→      pageWidth,
  1209→      pageHeight
  1210→    } = viewport.rawDims;
  1211→    const {
  1212→      style
  1213→    } = div;
  1214→    const useRound = util_FeatureTest.isCSSRoundSupported;
  1215→    const w = `var(--scale-factor) * ${pageWidth}px`, h = `var(--scale-factor) * ${pageHeight}px`;
  1216→    const widthStr = useRound ? `round(down, ${w}, var(--scale-round-x, 1px))` : `calc(${w})`, heightStr = useRound ? `round(down, ${h}, var(--scale-round-y, 1px))` : `calc(${h})`;
  1217→    if (!mustFlip || viewport.rotation % 180 === 0) {
  1218→      style.width = widthStr;
  1219→      style.height = heightStr;
  1220→    } else {
  1221→      style.width = heightStr;
  1222→      style.height = widthStr;
  1223→    }
  1224→  }
  1225→  if (mustRotate) {
  1226→    div.setAttribute("data-main-rotation", viewport.rotation);
  1227→  }
  1228→}
  1229→var OutputScale = class {

  1380→  #getLastPoint(boxes, isLTR) {
  1381→    let lastY = 0;
  1382→    let lastX = 0;
  1383→    for (const box of boxes) {
  1384→      const y = box.y + box.height;
  1385→      if (y < lastY) {
  1386→        continue;
  1387→      }
  1388→      const x = box.x + (isLTR ? box.width : 0);
  1389→      if (y > lastY) {
  1390→        lastX = x;
  1391→        lastY = y;
  1392→        continue;
  1393→      }
  1394→      if (isLTR) {
  1395→        if (x > lastX) {
  1396→          lastX = x;
  1397→        }
  1398→      } else if (x < lastX) {
  1399→        lastX = x;
  1400→      }
  1401→    }
  1402→    return [isLTR ? 1 - lastX : lastX, lastY];
  1403→  }
  1404→  show(parent, boxes, isLTR) {
  1405→    const [x, y] = this.#getLastPoint(boxes, isLTR);
  1406→    const {
  1407→      style
  1408→    } = this.#toolbar ||= this.#render();
  1409→    parent.append(this.#toolbar);
  1410→    style.insetInlineEnd = `${100 * x}%`;
  1411→    style.top = `calc(${100 * y}% + var(--editor-toolbar-vert-offset))`;
  1412→  }
  1413→  hide() {

  1415→  }
  1416→  #addHighlightButton() {

  1448→var ImageManager = class _ImageManager {
  1449→  #baseId = getUuid();
  1450→  #id = 0;
  1451→  #cache = null;
  1452→  static get _isSVGFittingCanvas() {
  1453→    const svg = `data:image/svg+xml;charset=UTF-8,<svg viewBox="0 0 1 1" width="1" height="1" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="1" height="1" style="fill:red;"/></svg>`;
  1454→    const canvas = new OffscreenCanvas(1, 3);
  1455→    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d", {
  1456→      willReadFrequently: true
  1457→    });
  1458→    const image = new Image();
  1459→    image.src = svg;
  1460→    const promise = image.decode().then(() => {
  1461→      ctx.drawImage(image, 0, 0, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1, 3);
  1462→      return new Uint32Array(ctx.getImageData(0, 0, 1, 1).data.buffer)[0] === 0;
  1463→    });
  1464→    return shadow(this, "_isSVGFittingCanvas", promise);
  1465→  }
  1466→  async #get(key, rawData) {
  1467→    this.#cache ||= /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  1468→    let data = this.#cache.get(key);
  1469→    if (data === null) {
  1470→      return null;
  1471→    }
  1472→    if (data?.bitmap) {
  1473→      data.refCounter += 1;
  1474→      return data;
  1475→    }
  1476→    try {
  1477→      data ||= {
  1478→        bitmap: null,
  1479→        id: `image_${this.#baseId}_${this.#id++}`,
  1480→        refCounter: 0,
  1481→        isSvg: false
  1482→      };
  1483→      let image;
  1484→      if (typeof rawData === "string") {
  1485→        data.url = rawData;
  1486→        image = await fetchData(rawData, "blob");
  1487→      } else if (rawData instanceof File) {
  1488→        image = data.file = rawData;
  1489→      } else if (rawData instanceof Blob) {
  1490→        image = rawData;
  1491→      }
  1492→      if (image.type === "image/svg+xml") {
  1493→        const mustRemoveAspectRatioPromise = _ImageManager._isSVGFittingCanvas;
  1494→        const fileReader = new FileReader();
  1495→        const imageElement = new Image();
  1496→        const imagePromise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
  1497→          imageElement.onload = () => {
  1498→            data.bitmap = imageElement;
  1499→            data.isSvg = true;
  1500→            resolve();
  1501→          };
  1502→          fileReader.onload = async () => {
  1503→            const url = data.svgUrl = fileReader.result;
  1504→            imageElement.src = await mustRemoveAspectRatioPromise ? `${url}#svgView(preserveAspectRatio(none))` : url;
  1505→          };
  1506→          imageElement.onerror = fileReader.onerror = reject;
  1507→        });
  1508→        fileReader.readAsDataURL(image);
  1509→        await imagePromise;
  1510→      } else {
  1511→        data.bitmap = await createImageBitmap(image);
  1512→      }
  1513→      data.refCounter = 1;
  1514→    } catch (e) {
  1515→      warn(e);
  1516→      data = null;
  1517→    }
  1518→    this.#cache.set(key, data);
  1519→    if (data) {
  1520→      this.#cache.set(data.id, data);
  1521→    }
  1522→    return data;
  1523→  }
  1524→  async getFromFile(file) {
  1525→    const {
  1526→      lastModified,
  1527→      name,
  1528→      size,
  1529→      type
  1530→    } = file;
  1531→    return this.#get(`${lastModified}_${name}_${size}_${type}`, file);
  1532→  }
  1533→  async getFromUrl(url) {
  1534→    return this.#get(url, url);
  1535→  }
  1536→  async getFromBlob(id, blobPromise) {
  1537→    const blob = await blobPromise;
  1538→    return this.#get(id, blob);
  1539→  }
  1540→  async getFromId(id) {
  1541→    this.#cache ||= /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  1542→    const data = this.#cache.get(id);
  1543→    if (!data) {
  1544→      return null;
  1545→    }
  1546→    if (data.bitmap) {
  1547→      data.refCounter += 1;
  1548→      return data;
  1549→    }
  1550→    if (data.file) {
  1551→      return this.getFromFile(data.file);
  1552→    }
  1553→    if (data.blobPromise) {
  1554→      const {
  1555→        blobPromise
  1556→      } = data;
  1557→      delete data.blobPromise;
  1558→      return this.getFromBlob(data.id, blobPromise);
  1559→    }
  1560→    return this.getFromUrl(data.url);
  1561→  }
  1562→  getFromCanvas(id, canvas) {
  1563→    this.#cache ||= /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  1564→    let data = this.#cache.get(id);
  1565→    if (data?.bitmap) {
  1566→      data.refCounter += 1;
  1567→      return data;
  1568→    }
  1569→    const offscreen = new OffscreenCanvas(canvas.width, canvas.height);
  1570→    const ctx = offscreen.getContext("2d");
  1571→    ctx.drawImage(canvas, 0, 0);
  1572→    data = {
  1573→      bitmap: offscreen.transferToImageBitmap(),
  1574→      id: `image_${this.#baseId}_${this.#id++}`,
  1575→      refCounter: 1,
  1576→      isSvg: false
  1577→    };
  1578→    this.#cache.set(id, data);
  1579→    this.#cache.set(data.id, data);
  1580→    return data;
  1581→  }
  1582→  getSvgUrl(id) {
  1583→    const data = this.#cache.get(id);
  1584→    if (!data?.isSvg) {
  1585→      return null;
  1586→    }
  1587→    return data.svgUrl;
  1588→  }
  1589→  deleteId(id) {
  1590→    this.#cache ||= /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  1591→    const data = this.#cache.get(id);
  1592→    if (!data) {
  1593→      return;
  1594→    }
  1595→    data.refCounter -= 1;
  1596→    if (data.refCounter !== 0) {
  1597→      return;
  1598→    }
  1599→    const {
  1600→      bitmap
  1601→    } = data;
  1602→    if (!data.url && !data.file) {
  1603→      const canvas = new OffscreenCanvas(bitmap.width, bitmap.height);
  1604→      const ctx = canvas.getContext("bitmaprenderer");
  1605→      ctx.transferFromImageBitmap(bitmap);
  1606→      data.blobPromise = canvas.convertToBlob();
  1607→    }
  1608→    bitmap.close?.();
  1609→    data.bitmap = null;
  1610→  }
  1611→  isValidId(id) {
  1612→    return id.startsWith(`image_${this.#baseId}_`);
  1613→  }
  1614→};
  1615→var CommandManager = class {
  1616→  #commands = [];
  1617→  #locked = false;
  1618→  #maxSize;
  1619→  #position = -1;
  1620→  constructor(maxSize = 128) {
  1621→    this.#maxSize = maxSize;
  1622→  }
  1623→  add({
  1624→    cmd,
  1625→    undo,
  1626→    post,
  1627→    mustExec,
  1628→    type = NaN,
  1629→    overwriteIfSameType = false,
  1630→    keepUndo = false
  1631→  }) {
  1632→    if (mustExec) {
  1633→      cmd();
  1634→    }
  1635→    if (this.#locked) {
  1636→      return;
  1637→    }
  1638→    const save = {
  1639→      cmd,
  1640→      undo,
  1641→      post,
  1642→      type
  1643→    };
  1644→    if (this.#position === -1) {
  1645→      if (this.#commands.length > 0) {
  1646→        this.#commands.length = 0;
  1647→      }
  1648→      this.#position = 0;
  1649→      this.#commands.push(save);
  1650→      return;
  1651→    }
  1652→    if (overwriteIfSameType && this.#commands[this.#position].type === type) {
  1653→      if (keepUndo) {
  1654→        save.undo = this.#commands[this.#position].undo;
  1655→      }
  1656→      this.#commands[this.#position] = save;
  1657→      return;
  1658→    }
  1659→    const next = this.#position + 1;
  1660→    if (next === this.#maxSize) {
  1661→      this.#commands.splice(0, 1);
  1662→    } else {
  1663→      this.#position = next;
  1664→      if (next < this.#commands.length) {
  1665→        this.#commands.splice(next);
  1666→      }
  1667→    }
  1668→    this.#commands.push(save);
  1669→  }
  1670→  undo() {
  1671→    if (this.#position === -1) {
  1672→      return;
  1673→    }
  1674→    this.#locked = true;
  1675→    const {
  1676→      undo,
  1677→      post
  1678→    } = this.#commands[this.#position];
  1679→    undo();
  1680→    post?.();
  1681→    this.#locked = false;
  1682→    this.#position -= 1;
  1683→  }
  1684→  redo() {
  1685→    if (this.#position < this.#commands.length - 1) {
  1686→      this.#position += 1;
  1687→      this.#locked = true;
  1688→      const {
  1689→        cmd,
  1690→        post
  1691→      } = this.#commands[this.#position];
  1692→      cmd();
  1693→      post?.();
  1694→      this.#locked = false;
  1695→    }
  1696→  }
  1697→  hasSomethingToUndo() {
  1698→    return this.#position !== -1;
  1699→  }
  1700→  hasSomethingToRedo() {
  1701→    return this.#position < this.#commands.length - 1;
  1702→  }
  1703→  cleanType(type) {
  1704→    if (this.#position === -1) {
  1705→      return;
  1706→    }
  1707→    for (let i = this.#position; i >= 0; i--) {
  1708→      if (this.#commands[i].type !== type) {
  1709→        this.#commands.splice(i + 1, this.#position - i);
  1710→        this.#position = i;
  1711→        return;
  1712→      }
  1713→    }
  1714→    this.#commands.length = 0;
  1715→    this.#position = -1;
  1716→  }
  1717→  destroy() {
  1718→    this.#commands = null;
  1719→  }
  1720→};
  1721→var KeyboardManager = class {
  1722→  constructor(callbacks) {
  1723→    this.buffer = [];
  1724→    this.callbacks = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  1725→    this.allKeys = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  1726→    const {
  1727→      isMac
  1728→    } = util_FeatureTest.platform;
  1729→    for (const [keys, callback, options = {}] of callbacks) {
  1730→      for (const key of keys) {
  1731→        const isMacKey = key.startsWith("mac+");

  1734→            callback,
  1735→            options
  1736→          });

  1741→            options
  1742→          });

  1748→  #serialize(event) {

  1750→      this.buffer.push("alt");
  1751→    }
  1752→    if (event.ctrlKey) {
  1753→      this.buffer.push("ctrl");
  1754→    }
  1755→    if (event.metaKey) {
  1756→      this.buffer.push("meta");
  1757→    }
  1758→    if (event.shiftKey) {
  1759→      this.buffer.push("shift");
  1760→    }
  1761→    this.buffer.push(event.key);
  1762→    const str = this.buffer.join("+");
  1763→    this.buffer.length = 0;
  1764→    return str;
  1765→  }
  1766→  exec(self, event) {
  1767→    if (!this.allKeys.has(event.key)) {
  1768→      return;
  1769→    }
  1770→    const info2 = this.callbacks.get(this.#serialize(event));
  1771→    if (!info2) {
  1772→      return;
  1773→    }
  1774→    const {
  1775→      callback,
  1776→      options: {
  1777→        bubbles = false,
  1778→        args = [],
  1779→        checker = null
  1780→      }
  1781→    } = info2;
  1782→    if (checker && !checker(self, event)) {
  1783→      return;
  1784→    }
  1785→    callback.bind(self, ...args, event)();
  1786→    if (!bubbles) {
  1787→      stopEvent(event);
  1788→    }
  1789→  }
